sam_pm: Quick check-in: Azure offer manifest for the VM/BringYourOwnLicense variant needs final sign-off. Also we have a partner ask from NVIDIA about GPU SKU naming. Can we align on residency wording for EU/UK?

sara_legal: Residency wording: "Customer data processed in the selected region; Redwood controls processing scope per DPA. Except where customer opts for dedicated on-prem, logs may be processed in partner regions for billing/telemetry." That should be safe, but for Azure EU-only we need to mark 'data_residency=EU'.

nvidia_partner: For marketplace listing we prefer GPU SKU tags like `nvidia-a100-40gb` and `nvidia-a10g-24gb`. Helps customers filter by accelerator. We'll provide AMI/VHD best-practices for drivers.

lina_packaging: VHDs built with GPU driver bundle. Uploading to staging storage account now. Added SKU mapping file in PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketplace-metadata/pull/58

eng_runtime: Reminder: runtime needs CUDA compatibility flags in the manifest and an init script for driver load. Also include `supports-passthrough: true` for Azure NV-series.

azure_pm: Two publishing notes: 1) offerType must be `VirtualMachine` for VM images, or `SaaS` for subscription SaaS. 2) For EU/UK residency Azure requires the `regionRestriction` property in the offer JSON.

ben_bizops: Pricing question: do we do VM-hour + token-metering hybrid? i.e., base VM hourly + usage-based tokens. Finance prefers bundle SKU e.g., `pro-hourly+a-token-meter`. Need meter names per cloud to mirror in billing.

tara_marketing: I'll draft short and long descriptions tailored to Azure Marketplace guidelines (1-line + 250-char). Also need a badge: "Trial 14 days" vs "Free tier included"? legal will decide trial copy.

sara_legal: Trial copy approved for Azure: "14-day trial available. Trial limited to one per customer. Purchase subject to Redwood Terms and DPA. Refunds handled per contract." Use exact phrasing in offers.

support_lead: PSA: onboarding docs for customers must include GPU troubleshooting section and driver install steps. adding to support playbook.

sam_pm: Here's the draft Azure offer manifest snippet (internal):
```yaml
offerId: redwood-inference-pro
offerType: VirtualMachine
plans:
  - planId: pro-hourly
    sku: nvidia-a100-40gb
    priceModel: hourly_base_plus_meter
    meters:
      - name: tokens_processed
        unit: token
        rate_usd: 0.0001
regionRestriction: ["westeurope","uksouth"]
data_residency: EU
```

eng_runtime: linter note: manifest must include `publisherId` and `supportContact`. add those before publish.

lina_packaging: Updated PR to include publisherId and changed priceModel to `composite` per schema. pushed commit.

ben_bizops: Finance ok with composite pricing. Confirm currency rounding and enterprise commit discounts. I'll add a `commit-tier` plan in the PR.

nvidia_partner: We'll provide validated images and a small docs package for GPU passthrough. Also want a co-branded line in marketing copy: please route approvals via partnerships.

sara_legal: Co-branding OK with standard partner acknowledgement. Send the asset and we'll approve.

alex_ops: (looping from infra) Need the storage account and role assignment for automated image ingestion. azure-automation role ARN will be posted here.

azure_pm: Confirmed role created: `roleId: azure-marketplace-ingest-2026`. Assign to publisher service principal.

deploy-bot: marketplace-manifest-lint: PASS on PR #58 after updates.

sam_pm: Final checklist: legal copy ✅, manifest schema ✅, SKU GPU tags ✅, finance pricing ✅, marketing assets pending. Target publish window tomorrow 09:00 PT. If no blockers, i'll open the partner portal submission. :rocket:

tara_marketing: I'll upload descriptions + co-brand asset today.

support_lead: I'll attach GPU troubleshooting doc to the offer support contact.

sara_legal: Closing my thread. Anything non-standard ping contracts.

sam_pm: Thanks all — moving to submit queue.
